description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Lowest listed OpenRouter price among models meeting your needs: the lowest-priced match (field `pick`) and the next-lowest from a different vendor, reasons, excluded counts per filter and vendor status-page readings, each with source and time. A price reading, not advice and not about model quality. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

capability.description: Comma list, all required: reasoning, coding, vision-input, image-output, audio, free-tier, tools, structured-output

exclude_vendor.description: Comma list of vendors to skip

max_input_per_1m.description: Max input price, USD per 1M tokens

max_job_cost_usd.description: Max cost of 10k input + 1k output tokens, USD

max_output_per_1m.description: Max output price, USD per 1M tokens

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
